title: Torque Converter
text: Three-part torque converter consisting of an impeller, turbine, and stator, 3 outputs, {Interpolation method} sets Select interpolation method; {Lock-up clutch configuration} selects lock-up clutch configuration, {Impeller shaft inertia, Ji} sets the inertia .1, {Impeller shaft viscous damping, bi} sets the viscous damping coefficient .001, {Turbine shaft inertia, Jt} sets the inertia .1, {Turbine shaft viscous damping, bt} sets the viscous damping coefficient .001, {Initial impeller shaft velocity, omegai_o} sets the angular velocity, {Initial turbine shaft velocity, omegat_o} sets the angular velocity, {Speed ratio vector, phi} sets the ratio, {Capacity factor parameterization} selects factor ratio type Input speed /, {Capacity vector, psi} sets the vector, {Torque ratio vector, zeta} sets the vector, {Fluid torque response time constant (set to 0 to disable), tauTC} sets the time constant .02, {Clutch force equivalent net radius, Reff} sets the effective radius .3, {Static friction coefficient, mus} sets the coefficient, {Kinetic friction coefficient, muk} sets the coefficient, {Start simulation with clutch initially locked} selects to initially lock clutch, {Lock-up speed ratio threshold, philu} sets the threshold .85, {Minimum lock-up engagement speed, omegal} sets the angular velocity, {Lock-up disengagement speed, omegau} sets the angular velocity, {Lock-up clutch force gain, K_c} sets the gain and {Lock-up clutch time constant, tauC} sets the time constant .0500. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Lock-up clutch configuration
params.values: Select lock-up clutch configuration Lock-up (default) | No lock-up | External lock-up input

params.name: Capacity factor parameterization
params.values: Select factor ratio type Input speed / sqrt(input torque) (default) | Absorbed torque / input speed^2

params.name: Fluid torque response time constant (set to 0 to disable), tauTC
Interpolation method
params.values: Select interpolation method Linear (default) | Flat | Nearest

params.name: Clutch force equivalent net radius, Reff
Start simulation with clutch initially locked
params.values: Select to initially lock clutch off (default) | on
